Apple Cash for familien

Når Familiedeling er aktivert, kan organisatoren i familien tillate at familiemedlemmer under 18 år, inkludert barn under 13 år, kan bruke Apple Cash. Apple bruker informasjonen som er oppgitt i registreringsprosessen for Apple Cash for familien, og deler informasjonen med Green Dot Bank for å konfigurere en barnekonto. Informasjon om Apple Cash-kontoen deles også med Green Dot Bank for å levere kontoen, forhindre svindel og overholde loven.

Familiens organisator kan begrense hvem et barn kan sende penger til via Meldinger, men hvem som helst kan sende penger til barnets konto. Apple lagrer restriksjonen for å overholde valgene til familiens organisator. Familiens organisator kan vise og endre barnets kontoinnstillinger for Apple Cash når som helst ved å trykke på barnets Apple Cash-kort i Lommebok, velge Innstillinger for Familiedeling > Familiedeling > Apple Cash og trykke på barnets navn.

Familiens organisator og barnets foreldre og verger kan også se saldo og full transaksjonslogg for barnets konto, inkludert beløp, datoer og hvem som har mottatt eller satt inn penger. Ytterligere transaksjonsinformasjon kan også vises ved behov, som beskrivelser i meldingsfeltet for en transaksjon i Meldinger. Hvis du vil se transaksjonsloggen for barnets konto, kan du trykke på Apple Cash-kortet i Lommebok, velg Innstillinger for Familiedeling > Familiedeling > Apple Cash > [barnets navn] > Transaksjoner.

Barn som er 13 år eller eldre, kan overføre penger til Apple Cash-kontoen sin selv. Overføring av penger er synlig for kontoens eier.

Når barnet fyller 18 år, kan de be om å få ta over eierskapet til den tilknyttede kontoen og endre den til en egen Apple Cash-konto. Etter oppdateringen vil ikke lenger familiens organisatorer, foreldre og verger ha tilgang til barnets kontoinformasjon eller informasjon om barnets tidligere eller fremtidige Apple Cash-transaksjoner. Den oppdaterte kontoen vil fremdeles ha tilgang til informasjon om transaksjoner som skjedde før oppdateringen.

Hvis barnet forlater familiegruppen, vil barnets tilknyttede konto stenges, og informasjon om kontoen vil bli behandlet som beskrevet i Stenging av Apple Cash-kontoen.

Hvis du vil ha mer informasjon om hvordan Apple behandler barns personlige data, kan du lese Familierelatert personvernmerknad for barn på www.apple.com/no/legal/privacy/no/parent-disclosure.

Annet

Funksjonene for direkte inn- eller utbetalinger som beskrevet over, leveres av Apple Payments Inc, som er ansvarlige for dine personlige data. Andre teknologiske tjenester knyttet til Apple Cash leveres av Apple Payments Services LLC, et heleid datterselskap av Apple.

Hvis du klager til finans­institusjonen din om en svindelaktig Apple Cash-transaksjon, kan Green Dot Bank be om at Apple deler enkelte opplysninger om den påklagede transaksjonen med dem, som f.eks. IP-adresse, Apple‑konto, telefonnummer og en enhetsidentifikator, for at de skal være i stand til å svare på forespørselen. Green Dot Bank kan dele denne transaksjons­relaterte informasjonen med finansinstitusjonen og betalingsnettverket (for eksempel Visa eller American Express) for å forhindre svindel. Du kan lese mer om hvordan Green Dot Bank beskytter og deler de personlige dataene dine, i retningslinjene deres for personvern på https://applecash.greendot.com/privacy.

For å kunne forbedre Apple Cash samler Apple inn og lagrer informasjon om bruken din av Apple Cash på en måte som ikke identifiserer deg personlig. Apple kan også bruke denne informasjonen til å forbedre andre relaterte produkter og tjenester fra Apple, til sikkerhetsformål og for å forhindre svindel. Apple kan også bruke visse typer ikke-identifiserende Apple Cash-informasjon fra Green Dot Bank, og bruke informasjonen til forretningsanalyse og for å forbedre Apple Cash og relaterte tjenester.

Apple oppbevarer personlige data kun så lenge som nødvendig for å utføre formålet de ble samlet inn for, inkludert som beskrevet i dette varselet, og i henhold til Apple retningslinjer for personvern eller gjeldende lover. Når vi avgjør hvor lenge data skal beholdes, undersøker vi først nøye om det i det hele tatt er nødvendig å beholde innsamlede personlige data, og hvis det kreves, prøver vi å beholde informasjonen så kort tid som tillatt i henhold til loven.

All informasjon Apple samler inn, behandles alltid i samsvar med Apples retningslinjer for personvern, som du kan lese på www.apple.com/no/privacy.

Apple Cash membenarkan anda menghantar dan menerima wang daripada orang lain serta menerima pembayaran dan membuat bayaran terus kepada perniagaan yang layak.

Membuat Bayaran Orang kepada Orang dan Menggunakan Apple Cash (Amerika Syarikat Sahaja)

Apple Cash membenarkan anda menghantar dan menerima wang daripada orang lain dalam Mesej, Wallet serta menggunakan Siri. Apabila anda menerima wang, ia ditambahkan ke kad Apple Cash anda yang boleh digunakan untuk membuat pembelian menggunakan Apple Pay di kedai, dalam app dan di web. Bayaran orang kepada orang dan akaun Apple Cash ialah perkhidmatan yang disediakan oleh bank rakan kongsi Apple, Green Dot Bank.

Menyediakan Apple Cash

Apabila anda menyediakan Apple Cash, maklumat pengenalpastian dan maklumat hubungan anda, serta maklumat yang sama seperti apabila anda menambah kad kredit atau debit mungkin dikongsi dengan Green Dot Bank dan dengan Apple Payments Inc.

Apple menubuhkan Apple Payments Inc., sebuah subsidiari milikan penuh dan pengirim wang berlesen, untuk melindungi privasi anda. Maklumat pendaftaran akaun Apple Cash anda (nama, alamat), baki, amaun transaksi dan individu yang anda hantar wang disimpan secara berasingan oleh Apple Payments Inc. Data peribadi anda yang disimpan dalam Apple Payments Inc. hanya digunakan untuk menyediakan perkhidmatan yang anda minta untuk penyelesaian masalah, tujuan kawal selia dan mencegah penipuan.

Selain itu, Apple Inc. akan mengetahui jika anda telah mendayakan Apple Cash, atau menggunakan perkhidmatan Apple Cash, seperti sama ada anda telah mendayakan Apple Cash Keluarga. Maklumat ini akan digunakan hanya untuk membantu anda menerokai dan menggunakan ciri Apple Cash dan Apple Pay.

Mengesahkan Identiti Anda

Anda mungkin diminta untuk memberikan maklumat, termasuk nama, alamat dan nombor Keselamatan Sosial anda kepada bank dan penyedia khidmat pengesahan identiti mereka untuk mengesahkan identiti anda dan mematuhi peraturan perbankan. Maklumat yang anda sediakan untuk mengesahkan identiti anda akan digunakan hanya untuk pencegahan penipuan dan mematuhi peraturan kewangan Amerika Syarikat. Nama dan alamat anda disimpan secara selamat oleh bank rakan kongsi dan Apple Payments Inc. Jika diperlukan untuk mengesahkan identiti, anda mungkin diminta memberikan maklumat tambahan, seperti tarikh lahir, jawapan untuk soalan (sebagai contoh, mengesahkan nama jalan tempat tinggal anda sebelum ini) atau salinan ID kerajaan anda. Maklumat tambahan ini tidak boleh dibaca oleh Apple Inc.

Untuk membantu mencegah penipuan sambil melindungi privasi anda, peranti anda mungkin menilai maklumat tentang corak penggunaan peranti dan akaun yang khusus, seperti peristiwa yang menandakan penipuan atau pengetahuan tentang pengirim atau penerima serta menjana penilaian risiko yang direka bentuk untuk membantu mencegah penipuan. Penilaian risiko ini — tetapi bukan maklumat mendasar — dikongsi secara boleh dikenal pasti dengan Apple Payments Inc. dan melalui cara yang tidak boleh mengaitkan anda dengan Apple, disimpan untuk tempoh masa terhad dan digunakan dalam keputusan penipuan untuk melindungi wang anda apabila menggunakan Apple Cash (contohnya, mencegah penipuan), mencegah penggunaan yang tidak dibenarkan dan membantu memastikan keselamatan keseluruhan platform Apple Cash. Contohnya, apabila anda memperuntukkan Apple Cash, sama seperti apabila anda menambahkan kad pada Apple Pay, peranti anda mungkin menilai corak penggunaan peranti (contohnya, peratusan masa peranti sedang dalam pergerakan, anggaran bilangan panggilan dalam seminggu). Tiada kandungan komunikasi anda disimpan. Transaksi yang memerlukan analisis lanjutan disebabkan aktiviti yang mencurigakan mungkin dikekalkan dan dikaitkan dengan anda. Anda boleh melihat transaksi yang perlu dianalisis lebih lanjut disebabkan aktiviti mencurigakan dengan pergi ke sejarah transaksi kad Apple Cash anda.

Maklumat yang Dikongsi Apabila Anda Menggunakan Apple Cash

Apabila anda menggunakan Apple Cash, termasuk apabila anda menambah wang atau memindahkan wang ke akaun bank, bank rakan kongsi kami, Apple dan Apple Payments Inc. mungkin menggunakan dan menyimpan maklumat tentang anda, peranti anda dan akaun bank anda untuk memproses transaksi, mencegah penipuan dan mematuhi peraturan kewangan. Maklumat ini serupa dengan maklumat yang diproses semasa anda menambah kad kredit atau debit, tetapi tidak termasuk lokasi peranti anda. Jika anda telah mendayakan Perkhidmatan Lokasi untuk Wallet, peranti anda juga akan menilai maklumat tentang lokasi peranti anda untuk membangunkan penilaian pencegahan penipuan pada peranti. Output penilaian, namun bukan data mendasar, akan dihantar kepada Apple. Kami juga mungkin berkongsi maklumat dengan bank rakan kongsi kami atau Apple untuk pencegahan penipuan dan untuk membantu menyediakan sokongan kepada anda. Apple Payments Inc. akan menyimpan dan menggunakan data transaksi anda untuk penyelesaian masalah, mencegah penipuan dan mematuhi peraturan kewangan. Untuk membantu melindungi anda daripada penipuan, apabila anda cuba melakukan transaksi yang kelihatan seperti penipuan, Apple Payments Inc. mungkin meminta maklumat daripada bank rakan kongsi kami tentang peristiwa berkaitan akaun Apple Cash, seperti kali terakhir anda berjaya mengesahkan identiti anda. Apple Payments Inc. akan menyimpan dan menggunakan data ini untuk mencegah penipuan.

Apabila anda menghantar atau meminta wang dalam Mesej atau Wallet, alamat e‑mel atau nombor telefon anda akan ditunjukkan kepada orang yang berurusan dengan anda. Untuk memilih atau menukar maklumat hubungan yang ditunjukkan semasa menghantar atau meminta daripada Mesej atau Wallet, pergi ke Seting > App > Mesej > Hantar & Terima. Apabila anda memindahkan wang ke akaun bank, maklumat bank anda, termasuk nombor akaun dan nombor penghalaan, akan disimpan dalam Rantai Kunci iCloud untuk memudahkan pemindahan masa depan. Maklumat ini disulitkan dan tidak boleh dibaca oleh Apple atau Apple Payments Inc.

Untuk memulakan transaksi Tap to Cash, anda boleh mengkonfigurasikan nama paparan dan foto, serta amaun transaksi pada peranti anda, membenarkan amaun, kemudian pegang peranti anda secara dekat dengan peranti penerima untuk mewujudkan sambungan peranti ke peranti. Selepas sambungan diwujudkan, peranti anda akan berkongsi nama dan foto paparan yang telah anda konfigurasikan serta amaun transaksi terus dengan peranti penerima. Penerima kemudian mempunyai peluang untuk menyemak dan menerima bayaran. Jika diterima, penerimaan penerima dan nama serta foto paparan dikonfigurasikan mereka adalah disulitkan dan dikongsi semula dengan peranti anda. Butiran tentang transaksi dibenarkan sepenuhnya kemudian dihantar oleh peranti anda kepada pelayan Apple Pay untuk pemprosesan.

Bayaran Terus dan Pembayaran

Apple Cash menggunakan Apple Payments Inc. untuk membenarkan perniagaan yang mengambil bahagian yang anda benarkan untuk membayar dana secara terus ke akaun Apple Cash anda. Apple Payments Inc. juga menyediakan Perkhidmatan Bayaran Terus, yang membenarkan anda menggunakan dana dalam akaun Apple Cash anda untuk membuat bayaran kepada perniagaan tertentu yang anda benarkan.

Maklumat tentang pembayaran yang anda terima atau bayaran terus yang anda lakukan digunakan oleh Green Dot Bank dan Apple Payments Inc. hanya untuk menyediakan perkhidmatan yang telah anda minta, untuk penyelesaian masalah, mematuhi undang-undang yang berkenaan dan mencegah penipuan bagi transaksi ini. Apple Payments Inc. menyimpan rekod transaksi, termasuk transaksi yang dibendera sebagai mencurigakan, seperti yang diperlukan oleh undang-undang persekutuan dan negeri untuk tempoh sehingga lima tahun.

Untuk membantu memastikan sebarang caj berulang atau caj yang dimulakan pedagang yang lain seperti langganan dibenarkan oleh anda, apabila anda memilih untuk menggunakan Apple Cash sebagai kaedah bayaran dengan pedagang yang mengambil bahagian untuk caj berulang atau caj yang dimulakan pedagang, Green Dot Bank dan Visa akan meluluskan serta menjana nombor akaun khusus pedagang menggunakan ciri token pedagang Apple Pay untuk digunakan bagi caj sedemikian. Hanya nombor akaun khusus pedagang tersebut boleh digunakan oleh pedagang khusus yang mengambil bahagian untuk membenarkan transaksi tanpa memerlukan anda melakukan tindakan tertentu. Apple akan mengetahui pedagang yang berkaitan dengan nombor akaun khusus pedagang anda, tetapi bukan perkara yang anda beli atau amaun yang anda bayar untuknya. Anda boleh mengurus nombor akaun khusus pedagang Apple Cash anda dalam Wallet dengan mengetik kad Apple Cash anda dan mengetik butang Lagi untuk melihat butiran kad.

Apabila anda menggunakan Apple Cash untuk bayaran berulang kepada rakan atau untuk menambah nilai baki Apple Cash anda secara automatik, Apple Cash meminta dan menyimpan token pedagang yang berkaitan dengan kad debit Apple Pay anda untuk membenarkan transaksi berulang secara selamat. Penjanaan token pedagang bergantung pada infrastruktur Apple, jadi Apple akan mengetahui bahawa anda telah menyediakan sama ada bayaran berulang atau tambah nilai auto dan amaun — tetapi tidak mengetahui pihak yang berurusan dengan anda atau memo yang anda kaitkan dengan bayaran.

Menutup Akaun Apple Cash Anda

Jika anda menutup akaun Apple Cash anda, maklumat tentang akaun, termasuk sejarah transaksi, akan dikekalkan seperti yang diperlukan oleh undang-undang dan untuk pencegahan penipuan.

Apple Cash Keluarga

Apabila Perkongsian Keluarga didayakan, Pengelola Keluarga boleh membenarkan ahli keluarga di bawah umur 18 tahun, termasuk mereka yang di bawah umur 13 tahun, menggunakan Apple Cash. Apple akan menggunakan maklumat yang diberikan dalam aliran suai tugas Apple Cash Keluarga dan berkongsi maklumat sedemikian dengan Green Dot Bank untuk menyediakan akaun kanak-kanak. Maklumat tentang akaun Apple Cash juga akan dikongsi dengan Green Dot Bank untuk menyediakan akaun, menghalang penipuan dan mematuhi undang-undang.

Pengelola Keluarga mungkin mengehadkan orang yang kanak-kanak mungkin menghantar wang menggunakan Mesej; sesiapa boleh menghantar wang kepada akaun kanak-kanak. Apple akan menyimpan pengehadan untuk menguatkuasakan pilihan Pengelola Keluarga. Pengelola Keluarga boleh melihat dan menukar seting akaun kanak-kanak Apple Cash pada bila-bila masa dengan mengetik kad Apple Cash mereka dalam Wallet, memilih Seting Perkongsian Keluarga > Perkongsian Keluarga > Apple Cash dan mengetik nama kanak-kanak.

Pengelola Keluarga dan ibu bapa serta penjaga sah juga dapat melihat baki dan sejarah transaksi penuh untuk akaun kanak-kanak, termasuk amaun, tarikh dan entiti atau orang yang melakukan transaksi. Butiran transaksi tambahan juga mungkin ditunjukkan jika tersedia, seperti perihalan yang disediakan dalam medan memo transaksi dalam Mesej. Untuk melihat sejarah transaksi akaun kanak-kanak, ketik kad Apple Cash dalam Wallet, pilih Seting Perkongsian Keluarga > Perkongsian Keluarga > Apple Cash > [nama kanak-kanak] > Transaksi.

Kanak-kanak berumur 13 tahun dan ke atas boleh memuatkan dana ke akaun Apple Cash mereka. Sebarang pemuatan dana akan kelihatan kepada pemilik akaun.

Apabila kanak-kanak berumur 18 tahun, mereka boleh meminta untuk mengambil pemilikan akaun dikaitkan mereka dan menukarkannya kepada akaun Apple Cash kendiri. Setelah penukaran, Pengelola Keluarga dan ibu bapa atau penjaga sah tidak lagi akan dapat mengakses maklumat akaun kanak-kanak atau maklumat tentang transaksi Apple Cash kanak-kanak pada masa lalu atau akan datang. Akaun yang ditukarkan akan terus melihat maklumat tentang transaksi yang berlaku sebelum penukaran.

Jika kanak-kanak meninggalkan Keluarga, akaun kanak-kanak yang dikaitkan akan ditutup dan maklumat tentang akaun akan dikendalikan seperti yang diterangkan di atas dalam Menutup Akaun Apple Cash Anda.

Untuk mendapatkan maklumat tentang pengendalian data peribadi kanak-kanak oleh Apple, lihat Pendedahan Privasi Keluarga untuk Kanak-kanak di www.apple.com/legal/privacy/my/parent-disclosure.

Jika anda memulakan aduan dengan institusi kewangan anda tentang transaksi Apple Cash berbentuk penipuan, Green Dot Bank mungkin meminta Apple berkongsi maklumat tertentu berkaitan transaksi yang dipertikaikan dengan Green Dot Bank untuk membantu membalas pertanyaan anda, seperti alamat IP, Akaun Apple, nombor telefon dan pengecam peranti. Untuk membantu meningkatkan Apple Cash, Apple mengumpulkan maklumat tentang penggunaan Apple Cash oleh anda dan menyimpan maklumat tersebut dengan cara yang tidak mengenal pasti anda secara peribadi. Apple juga boleh menggunakan maklumat ini untuk meningkatkan produk dan perkhidmatan Apple yang lain, untuk pemasaran dan bagi tujuan pencegahan penipuan serta keselamatan. Apple juga boleh mengakses maklumat Apple Cash dinyahkenalpasti tertentu daripada Green Dot Bank dan menggunakan maklumat tersebut untuk analitis perniagaan serta meningkatkan Apple Cash dan perkhidmatan berkaitan.

Apple mengekalkan data peribadi hanya setakat yang perlu untuk memenuhi tujuan yang data tersebut dikumpulkan, termasuk seperti yang diterangkan dalam notis ini dan berpandukan Dasar Privasi Apple atau seperti yang diperlukan oleh undang-undang. Apabila menilai tempoh pengekalan, kami mengkaji dengan teliti terlebih dahulu sama ada perlu mengekalkan data peribadi yang dikumpulkan, jika pengekalan diperlukan, berusaha untuk mengekalkan data peribadi bagi tempoh paling singkat yang dibenarkan di bawah undang-undang.

Pada setiap masa, maklumat yang dikumpulkan oleh Apple akan dikendalikan berpandukan Dasar Privasi Apple, yang boleh didapati di www.apple.com/my/privacy.

プライバシーを保護しながら詐欺を防止するために、詐欺を示す事象や親交のある送信者または受信者など、特定のデバイスやアカウントの使用パターンに関する情報がデバイスで評価されて、詐欺防止のために設計されたリスク評価が生成されることがあります。リスク評価（基となる情報ではなく）は、個人を特定できる形で、かつAppleであなたに関連付けることができない方法でApple Payments Inc.と共有され、期間限定で保存され、Apple Cashの使用時にあなたのお金を保護するため、不正使用を防止するため、およびApple Cashプラットフォーム全体の安全性を確実にするために詐欺の判定に使用されます。例えば、Apple Payにカードを追加する場合と同様に、Apple Cashを有効にすると、デバイスの使用パターン（例: デバイスが移動している時間の割合、1週間あたりのおおよその通話回数）がデバイスで評価されることもあります。やりとりの内容は収集されません。不審な活動によりさらなる解析が必要な取引は、保持され、あなたと関連付けられることがあります。不審な活動によりさらなる解析が必要な取引は、Apple Cashカードの利用明細をご覧ください。

Apple Cashの使用時に共有される情報

カードへ入金または銀行口座への送金を含み、Apple Cashを使用するとき、取引の処理、不正行為の防止、および金融規制に準拠するため、パートナー銀行、Apple、およびApple Payments Inc.はあなた個人、デバイス、および銀行口座に関する情報を使用する可能性があります。この情報はクレジットカードまたはデビットカードを追加するときに処理されるものに似ていますが、デバイスの所在地は含まれません。ウォレットで位置情報サービスを有効にしている場合、不正行為防止の評価をデバイス上で行う機能の開発を目的として、デバイスの位置情報もデバイスで評価されます。Appleに送信されるのは評価結果で、基となるデータは送信されません。詐欺を防止するため、およびサポートを提供するために、パートナー銀行またはAppleと情報を共有する場合もあります。トラブルシューティング、詐欺防止、および金融規制に準拠するため、Apple Payments Inc.はあなたの取引データを保管および使用する場合があります。詐欺からあなたを保護するため、あなたが不正取引と思われる取引をしようとしたときに、Apple Payments Inc.は、パートナー銀行のApple Cash口座関連のイベント（最後に本人確認が正常に完了したのはいつかなど）に関する情報をリクエストする場合があります。Apple Payments Inc.はこのデータを詐欺防止のために保管および使用します。

“メッセージ”またはウォレットで送金や支払いを要求する場合、メールアドレスまたは電話番号が取引を行う相手に表示されます。“メッセージ”やウォレットで送金や支払いを要求するときに表示される連絡先情報を選択または変更するには、“設定”＞“アプリ”＞“メッセージ”＞“送受信”に移動します。銀行口座に送金するとき、口座番号およびルーティング番号を含んだ情報が、今後の送金を簡素化するためにiCloudキーチェーンに保管されます。この情報は暗号化されAppleまたはApple Payments Inc.により読み取られることはありません。

Tap to Cash取引を開始するには、デバイス上で表示名、写真、取引額を設定し、取引額を承認してから、あなたのデバイスを受領者のデバイスに近づけてデバイス間接続を確立します。接続が確立されると、あなたのデバイスで、設定した表示名と写真、および取引額が受領者のデバイスと直接共有されます。受領者には支払いを確認して受け入れる機会が与えられます。受け入れられた場合、受領者が受け入れたことと、受領者の設定した表示名および写真が暗号化され、あなたのデバイスに共有されます。完全に承認された取引の詳細が処理のためにデバイスからApple Payのサーバに渡されます。

口座振替と直接入金

Apple Cashでは、Apple Payments Inc.を通じて、あなたが承認した参加企業から直接あなたのApple Cash口座にお金を振り込むことができます。Apple Payments Inc.は口座振替サービスも提供しているため、Apple Cash口座の残高を使って、あなたが承認した特定の企業にお金を支払うことができます。

振込の受領または口座振替の実施に関する情報は、Green Dot BankおよびApple Payments Inc.により、ご本人から依頼を受けたサービスの提供、取引に対するトラブルシューティング、適用法令の遵守、および詐欺防止の目的のためだけに使用されます。Apple Payments Inc.は、連邦法および州法の定めるところにより、不審と判断した取引を含め、取引レコードを最長5年間保持します。

定期的な請求や店舗主導のその他の請求（サブスクリプションなど）があなたによって許可されていることを確認するために、加盟店での定期的な請求や店舗主導の請求用の支払い方法としてApple Cashを使用することを選択すると、Green Dot BankやVisaによって、Apple Payの店舗トークン機能を使用して店舗固有のアカウント番号が承認および生成されて、該当する支払いに使用されます。その店舗固有のアカウント番号だけが特定の加盟店によって使用され、あなたが特定のアクションを実行しなくても加盟店は取引を承認できます。Appleは、あなたの店舗固有のアカウント番号に関連付けられている店舗は把握しますが、購入内容や支払い額は把握しません。あなたのApple Cashの店舗固有のアカウント番号は、ウォレットで、Apple Cashカードをタップし、“その他”ボタンをタップしてカードの詳細情報を表示することにより管理できます。

友達への定期的な支払いやApple Cash残高の自動チャージにApple Cashを使用する場合、定期的な取引を安全に承認するため、Apple CashによってApple Payのデビットカードに関連付けられている店舗トークンが要求および保存されます。店舗トークンの生成にはAppleのインフラストラクチャを利用するため、Appleは、あなたが定期的な支払いまたは自動チャージを設定していることを知ることになりますが、取引相手や、支払いに関連付けられたメモを知ることはありません。

Apple Cashアカウントの閉鎖

Apple Cashアカウントを閉鎖すると、利用明細を含むアカウント情報は法律の定めるところにより、および詐欺の防止のため、留保されます。

Apple Cashファミリー

ファミリー共有が有効になっている場合、ファミリー管理者は、13歳未満を含む18歳未満のファミリーメンバーにApple Cashの使用を許可できます。Appleは、Apple Cashファミリー開始時のフローで提供される情報を使用して、この情報をGreen Dot Bankと共有し、お子様用の子アカウントを開設します。Apple Cashアカウントに関する情報も、アカウントの提供、不正行為の防止、および法律の遵守のためにGreen Dot Bankと共有されます。

ファミリー管理者は、お子様がメッセージを使用して送金できる相手を制限できます。子アカウントには誰でも送金できます。Appleは、ファミリー管理者の選択を適用するために、この制限を保存します。ファミリー管理者は、ウォレットでApple Cashカードをタップし、“ファミリー共有設定”＞“ファミリー共有”＞“Apple Cash”を選択してお子様の名前をタップすることにより、いつでもApple Cash子アカウントの設定を表示および変更できます。

ファミリー管理者、保護者、法定後見人は、金額、日付、取引先のエンティティまたは個人を含む、子アカウントの残高と完全な取引履歴も表示できます。“メッセージ”での取引のメモフィールドに提供される説明など、取引に関する追加の詳細がある場合はそれも表示されます。子アカウントの取引履歴を表示するには、ウォレットでApple Cashカードをタップし、“ファミリー共有設定”＞“ファミリー共有”＞“Apple Cash”＞“[お子様の名前]”＞“ご利用明細”を選択します。

13歳以上のお子様は、Apple Cashアカウントに資金を入金できます。入金された資金はアカウント所有者に表示されます。

お子様が18歳になると、リンクされたアカウントの所有権を取得して、Apple Cashアカウントを独立させることを要求できます。独立させると、ファミリー管理者と保護者または法定後見人は、子アカウントの情報またはお子様の過去または将来のApple Cash取引に関する情報にアクセスできなくなります。独立したアカウントには、独立以前に発生した取引に関する情報が引き続き表示されます。

お子様がファミリーを離れると、リンクされた子アカウントが閉鎖され、アカウントに関する情報は上記のApple Cashアカウントの閉鎖で説明されているように処理されます。

Appleによるお子様の個人データの取り扱いについては、www.apple.com/legal/privacy/parent-disclosure の“子どもに関する家族のプライバシー開示”を参照してください。

その他

Apple Cash allows you to send and receive money from other people, and to receive disbursements from and make direct payments to eligible businesses.

Making Person-to-Person Payments and Using Apple Cash (United States Only)

Apple Cash allows you to send and receive money from other people in Messages and Wallet, and by using Siri. When you receive money, it’s added to your Apple Cash card that can be used to make purchases using Apple Pay in shops, in apps and on the web. Person-to-person payments and the Apple Cash account are services provided by Apple’s partner bank, Green Dot Bank.

Setting Up Apple Cash

When you set up Apple Cash, your identifying information and contact information, as well as the same information as when you add a credit or debit card, may be shared with Green Dot Bank and Apple Payments Inc.

Apple created Apple Payments Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary and licensed money transmitter, to protect your privacy. Your Apple Cash account registration information (name, address), balance, transaction amount and who you send money to are stored separately by Apple Payments Inc. Your personal data stored with Apple Payments Inc. is used only to provide you with services you request, for troubleshooting and regulatory purposes, and to prevent fraud.

In addition, Apple Inc. will know if you have enabled Apple Cash or used Apple Cash services, such as Apple Cash Family. This information will be used only to help you discover and use Apple Cash and Apple Pay features.

Verifying Your Identity

You may be asked to provide information, including your name, address and Social Security number, to the bank and their identity verification service provider to verify your identity and to comply with banking regulations. Information you provide to verify your identity will be used only for fraud prevention and to comply with United States financial regulations. Your name and address are securely stored by the partner bank and Apple Payments Inc. If needed to verify your identity, you may be asked to provide additional information, such as date of birth, answers to questions (for example, confirming a street name you have previously lived on) or a copy of your government ID. This additional information cannot be read by Apple Inc.

To help prevent fraud while protecting your privacy, your device may evaluate information about specific device and account use patterns, such as events indicative of scams or familiarity with a sender or recipient, and generate risk assessments. These risk assessments — but not the underlying information — are shared identifiably with Apple Payments Inc. and in a way that cannot be linked to you with Apple, are stored for a limited time, and are used in fraud decisions to safeguard your money when using Apple Cash (for example, preventing scams), prevent unauthorised use, and help ensure the overall safety of the Apple Cash platform. For example, when you provision Apple Cash, just as when you add a card to Apple Pay, your device may evaluate device use patterns (for example, percentage of time device is in motion, approximate number of calls per week). No content of your communication is collected. Transactions requiring further analysis due to suspicious activity may be retained and linked to you. You can view which transactions required further analysis due to suspicious activity by going to your Apple Cash card transaction history.

Information Shared When You Use Apple Cash

When you use Apple Cash, including when you add money or transfer money to a bank account, our partner bank, Apple and Apple Payments Inc. may use and store information about you, your device and your bank account in order to process the transaction, prevent fraud and comply with financial regulations. This information is similar to that processed when you add a credit or debit card, but does not include the location of your device. If you have enabled Location Services for Wallet, your device will also evaluate information about your device’s location to develop on-device fraud prevention assessments. The output of the assessments, but not the underlying data, will be sent to Apple. We may also share information with our partner bank or Apple for fraud prevention and to help provide you with support. Apple Payments Inc. will store and use your transaction data for troubleshooting, to prevent fraud and to comply with financial regulations. To help protect you against scams, when you attempt a transaction that appears fraudulent, Apple Payments Inc. may request information from our partner bank about Apple Cash account–related events, such as when you last successfully verified your identity. Apple Payments Inc. will store and use this data to prevent fraud.

When you send or request money in Messages or Wallet, your email address or phone number will be shown to the people you transact with. To select or change the contact information shown when sending or requesting from Messages or Wallet, go to Settings > Apps > Messages > Send & Receive. When you transfer money to a bank account, your bank information, including account number and sort code, will be stored within iCloud Keychain to simplify future transfers. This information is encrypted and cannot be read by Apple or Apple Payments Inc.

To initiate a Tap to Cash transaction, you may configure a display name and photo and transaction amount on your device, authorise the amount, and then hold your device in close proximity to the recipient device to establish a device-to-device connection. Once the connection is established, your device will share the display name and photo you have configured and the transaction amount directly with the recipient device. The recipient then has the opportunity to review and accept the payment. If accepted, the recipient’s acceptance and their configured display name and photo are encrypted and shared back with your device. Details on the fully authorised transaction are then passed by your device to Apple Pay servers for processing.

Direct Payments and Disbursements

Apple Cash uses Apple Payments Inc. to allow participating businesses that you authorise to disburse funds directly to your Apple Cash account. Apple Payments Inc. also provides the Direct Payments Service, which allows you to use funds in your Apple Cash account to make payments to certain businesses that you authorise.

Information about disbursements you receive or direct payments you make is used by Green Dot Bank and Apple Payments Inc. only to provide the service you have requested, to troubleshoot, to comply with applicable laws and to prevent fraud for these transactions. Apple Payments Inc. retains transaction records, including transactions flagged as suspicious, as required by US federal and state law for a period of up to five years.

To help ensure that any recurring or other merchant-initiated charges like subscriptions are authorised by you, when you choose to use Apple Cash as a payment method with participating merchants for recurring or merchant-initiated charges, Green Dot Bank and Visa will approve and generate a merchant-specific account number using Apple Pay’s merchant token feature to be used for such charges. Only that merchant-specific account number can be used by the specific participating merchant to authorise transactions without requiring you to take specific action. Apple will know which merchants are associated with your merchant-specific account numbers, but not what you purchased or how much you paid for it. You can manage your Apple Cash merchant-specific account numbers in Wallet by tapping your Apple Cash card and tapping the More button to view card details.

When you use Apple Cash for a recurring payment to a friend or to automatically reload your Apple Cash balance, Apple Cash requests and stores a merchant token associated with your Apple Pay debit card(s) to securely authorise recurring transactions. Merchant token generation relies on Apple infrastructure, so Apple will know that you have set up either a recurring payment or auto reload and the amount, but won’t know who you’re transacting with or the memo you associated with the payment.

Closing Your Apple Cash Account

If you close your Apple Cash account, information about the account, including transaction history, will be retained as required by law and for fraud prevention.

Apple Cash Family

When Family Sharing is enabled, a Family Organiser may allow family members under the age of 18, including those under the age of 13, to use Apple Cash. Apple will use information provided in the Apple Cash Family onboarding flow and share such information with Green Dot Bank to set up the child account. Information about the Apple Cash account will also be shared with Green Dot Bank to provide the account, prevent fraud and comply with law.

Family Organisers may limit to whom a child may send money using Messages; anyone can send money to the child’s account. Apple will store the restriction to enforce the Family Organiser’s choices. The Family Organiser may view and change the Apple Cash child account settings at any time by tapping their Apple Cash card in Wallet, selecting Family Sharing Settings > Family Sharing > Apple Cash and tapping the child’s name.

Family Organisers and parents and legal guardians will also be able to view the balance and full transaction history for a child account, including amounts, dates, and entities or persons transacted with. Additional transaction details may also be shown if available, such as descriptions provided in the memo field of a transaction in Messages. To view the child account transaction history, tap the Apple Cash card in Wallet, select Family Sharing Settings > Family Sharing > Apple Cash > [child’s name] > Transactions.

Children aged 13 and over may load funds into their Apple Cash account. Any loading of funds will be visible to the account owner.

When a child turns 18, they can request to take ownership of their linked account and graduate it to a standalone Apple Cash account. Upon graduation, Family Organisers and parents or legal guardians will no longer be able to access the child’s account information or information about the child’s past or future Apple Cash transactions. The graduated account will continue to see information about transactions that occurred prior to graduation.

If the child leaves the Family, the linked child account will be closed, and information about the account will be handled as described above in Closing Your Apple Cash Account.

For information on Apple’s handling of children’s personal data, see the Family Privacy Disclosure for Children at apple.com/legal/privacy/en-ww/parent-disclosure.

Other

The direct payments or disbursements features described above are provided by Apple Payments Inc., which is responsible for the related personal data processing. Other Apple Cash technology services are provided by Apple Payments Services LLC, an Apple wholly owned subsidiary.

If you initiate a complaint with your financial institution about a fraudulent Apple Cash transaction, Green Dot Bank may request that Apple share with Green Dot Bank certain information relating to the disputed transaction to help respond to your inquiry, such as the IP address, Apple Account, telephone number and a device identifier. Green Dot Bank may share this transaction-related information with your financial institution and the payment network (for example, Visa or American Express) for fraud prevention. You can learn more about how Green Dot Bank protects and shares your personal data by reviewing their privacy policy at https://applecash.greendot.com/privacy.

To help improve Apple Cash, Apple collects information about your use of Apple Cash and stores that information in a way that does not identify you personally. Apple may also use this information to improve other Apple products and services, for marketing, and for fraud and security purposes. Apple may also access certain de-identified Apple Cash information from Green Dot Bank and use that information for business analytics and to improve Apple Cash and related services.

Apple retains personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, including as described in this notice and in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, or as required by law. When assessing retention periods, we first carefully examine whether it is necessary to retain the personal data collected and, if retention is required, work to retain the personal data for the shortest period permissible by law.

At all times, information collected by Apple will be treated in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, which can be found at www.apple.com/in/privacy.

Apple Cash vă permite să trimiteți și să primiți bani de la alte persoane și să efectuați plăți directe către companiile eligibile, respectiv să primiți plăți de la acestea.

Efectuarea plăților între persoane și utilizarea Apple Cash (doar în S.U.A.)

Configurarea Apple Cash

Atunci când configurați Apple Cash, informațiile dvs. de identificare și de contact, precum și aceleași informații ca atunci când adăugați un card de credit sau de debit, pot fi partajate cu Green Dot Bank și cu Apple Payments Inc.

Apple a creat Apple Payments Inc., o filială deținută integral și un serviciu licențiat de transfer de bani, pentru a vă proteja intimitatea. Verificarea identității dvs.

Este posibil să vi se ceară să furnizați băncii și furnizorului serviciului de identificare al acesteia informații, inclusiv numele dvs., adresa și numărul de asigurare socială, pentru a vi se verifica identitatea și pentru respectarea reglementărilor bancare. Informațiile pe care le furnizați pentru verificarea identității dvs. vor fi utilizate doar pentru prevenirea fraudelor și pentru respectarea reglementărilor financiare din S.U.A. Numele și adresa dvs. sunt stocate în mod securizat de banca parteneră și de Apple Payments Inc. Dacă este necesară verificarea identității dvs., este posibil să vi se ceară să furnizați informații suplimentare, precum data nașterii, răspunsuri la întrebări (de exemplu, să confirmați numele străzii unde ați locuit anterior) sau o copie a actului dvs. de identitate. Aceste informații suplimentare nu pot fi citite de Apple Inc.

Pentru a contribui la prevenirea fraudelor, protejându‑vă în același timp intimitatea, dispozitivul dvs. poate să analizeze informații despre anumite tipare de utilizare a dispozitivelor și conturilor, cum ar fi evenimente care indică escrocherii sau familiaritate cu un expeditor sau destinatar, și să genereze evaluări de risc. Aceste evaluări de risc, dar nu și informațiile care stau la baza acestora, sunt partajate într‑un mod identificabil cu Apple Payments Inc. și într‑un mod care nu poate fi asociat cu dvs. cu Apple, sunt stocate pe o perioadă limitată și sunt utilizate în decizii privind fraudele pentru a vă proteja banii atunci când utilizați Apple Cash (de exemplu, prevenind escrocheriile), pentru a împiedica utilizarea neautorizată și pentru a contribui la asigurarea siguranței generale a platformei Apple Cash. De exemplu, atunci când aprovizionați Apple Cash, la fel ca atunci când adăugați un card la Apple Pay, dispozitivul dvs. poate evalua tiparele de utilizare a dispozitivului (de exemplu, procentul de timp în care dispozitivul este în mișcare sau numărul aproximativ de apeluri pe săptămână). Conținutul comunicărilor dvs. nu este colectat. Tranzacțiile care necesită analiză suplimentară din cauza unor activități suspecte pot fi reținute și asociate cu dvs. Puteți vedea ce tranzacții au necesitat o analiză suplimentară din cauza unor activități suspecte accesând istoricul tranzacțiilor cardului dvs. Apple Cash.

Informațiile partajate atunci când utilizați Apple Cash

Atunci când utilizați Apple Cash, inclusiv atunci când adăugați sau transferați bani într‑un cont bancar, banca parteneră, Apple și Apple Payments Inc. pot utiliza și stoca informații despre dvs., dispozitivul dvs. și contul dvs. bancar pentru procesarea tranzacției, prevenirea fraudelor și respectarea reglementărilor financiare. Aceste informații sunt similare celor procesate când adăugați un card de credit sau de debit, dar nu includ localizarea dispozitivului dvs. Dacă ați activat serviciile de localizare pentru Portofel, dispozitivul dvs. va analiza și informațiile despre localizarea dispozitivului pentru a realiza evaluări de prevenire a fraudelor pe dispozitiv. Rezultatele evaluărilor, însă nu și datele care stau la baza acestora, vor fi trimise la Apple. Informațiile pot fi partajate și cu banca parteneră sau cu Apple în scopul prevenirii fraudelor și pentru a vă putea acorda asistență. Apple Payments Inc. va stoca și utiliza datele tranzacției pentru depanare, pentru a preveni fraudele și pentru a respecta reglementările financiare. Pentru a vă proteja împotriva escrocheriilor, atunci când încercați să efectuați o tranzacție care pare frauduloasă, Apple Payments Inc. poate solicita de la banca parteneră informații despre evenimentele legate de contul Apple Cash, de exemplu, când a avut loc ultima verificare reușită a identității dvs. Apple Payments Inc. va stoca și utiliza aceste date pentru a preveni fraudele.

Când trimiteți sau solicitați bani folosind aplicațiile Mesaje sau Portofel, persoana cu care realizați tranzacția va vedea adresa de e‑mail sau numărul dvs. de telefon. Pentru a selecta sau modifica informațiile de contact afișate atunci când trimiteți sau solicitați bani din aplicațiile Mesaje sau Portofel, accesați Configurări > Aplicații > Mesaje > Trimitere și primire. Atunci când transferați bani într‑un cont bancar, informațiile dvs. bancare, inclusiv numărul contului și numărul de rutare, vor fi stocate în cadrul portcheiului iCloud pentru a simplifica transferurile ulterioare. Aceste informații sunt criptate și nu pot fi citite de Apple sau Apple Payments Inc.

Pentru a iniția o tranzacție „Tap to Cash”, puteți configura pe dispozitivul dvs. un nume și o poză de afișat și valoarea tranzacției, autorizați valoarea, apoi țineți dispozitivul propriu în apropierea dispozitivului destinatarului pentru a stabili o conexiune de la un dispozitiv la altul. După stabilirea conexiunii, dispozitivul dvs. va partaja direct cu dispozitivul destinatarului numele și poza de afișat pe care le‑ați configurat și valoarea tranzacției. Destinatarul are apoi posibilitatea de a verifica și accepta plata. Dacă este acceptată, acordul destinatarului împreună cu numele și poza de afișare configurate ale acestuia sunt criptate și partajate cu dispozitivul dvs. Detaliile despre tranzacția complet autorizată sunt transmise apoi pentru procesare de pe dispozitivul dvs. pe serverele Apple Pay.

Plățile directe și sumele primite

Apple Cash utilizează Apple Payments Inc. pentru a le permite companiilor participante pe care le autorizați să vă trimită fonduri direct în contul dvs. Apple Cash. De asemenea, Apple Payments Inc. furnizează serviciul de plăți directe, care vă permite să utilizați fondurile din contul dvs. Apple Cash pentru a efectua plăți anumitor companii pe care le autorizați.

Informațiile referitoare la sumele pe care le primiți sau la plățile directe pe care le efectuați sunt utilizate de Green Dot Bank și de Apple Payments Inc. doar pentru furnizarea serviciului pe care l-ați solicitat, pentru depanare, respectarea legilor în vigoare și prevenirea fraudelor legate de aceste tranzacții. Apple Payments Inc. păstrează înregistrările tranzacțiilor, inclusiv tranzacțiile marcate drept suspecte, conform cerințelor legii federale și de stat pentru o perioadă de cel mult cinci ani.

Pentru a asigura autorizarea de către dvs. a oricăror solicitări de plată recurente sau altor solicitări de plată inițiate de comercianți, precum cele pentru abonamente, atunci când optați să utilizați Apple Cash ca metodă de plată la comercianții participanți pentru solicitări de plată recurente sau inițiate de comerciant, Green Dot Bank și Visa vor aproba și genera un număr de cont specific comerciantului utilizând funcționalitatea Apple Pay de token pentru comercianți, care să fie folosit pentru asemenea solicitări de plată. Doar respectivul număr de cont specific comerciantului poate fi utilizat de comerciantul participant respectiv pentru a autoriza tranzacțiile fără să fie nevoie ca dvs. să întreprindeți o acțiune specifică. Apple va ști ce comercianți sunt asociați cu numerele de cont specifice comercianților, dar nu ce ați achiziționat sau cât ați plătit pentru achiziție. Puteți gestiona numerele de cont specifice comercianților Apple Cash în Portofel, apăsând pe cardul Apple Cash și apăsând pe butonul Mai multe pentru a vedea detaliile cardului.

Atunci când utilizați Apple Cash pentru o plată recurentă către un prieten sau pentru a reîncărca în mod automat soldul Apple Cash, Apple Cash solicită și stochează un token pentru comerciant asociat cardului de debit Apple Pay pentru a autoriza în mod securizat tranzacțiile recurente. Generarea tokenurilor pentru comercianți este bazată pe infrastructura Apple, deci Apple va știi că ați configurat o plată recurentă sau o reîncărcare automată și care este suma, dar nu va știi cu cine realizați tranzacția sau ce notă ați asociat plății.

Închiderea contului dvs. Apple Cash

Dacă închideți contul dvs. Apple Cash, informații despre cont, inclusiv istoricul tranzacțiilor, vor fi păstrate conform legii și pentru prevenirea fraudelor.

Apple Cash pentru familie

Când funcționalitatea „Partajare familială” este activată, un organizator al familiei le poate permite membrilor familiei cu vârsta sub 18 ani, inclusiv celor cu vârsta sub 13 ani, să utilizeze Apple Cash. Apple va utiliza informațiile furnizate în procesul de configurare „Apple Cash pentru familie” și va partaja aceste informații cu Green Dot Bank pentru a configura contul de copil. Informațiile despre contul Apple Cash vor fi de asemenea partajate cu Green Dot Bank pentru furnizarea contului, prevenirea fraudelor și respectarea legii.

Organizatorii familiei pot limita destinatarii cărora un copil le poate trimite bani utilizând Mesaje; oricine poate trimite bani în contul copilului. Apple va stoca restricțiile respective pentru a aplica alegerile organizatorului familiei. Organizatorul familiei poate vizualiza și schimba oricând configurările contului Apple Cash al copilului apăsând pe cardul Apple Cash propriu din Portofel, selectând Configurări Partajare familială > Partajare familială > Apple Cash și apăsând pe numele copilului.

Organizatorii familiei, precum și părinții și tutorii legali, vor putea de asemenea să vizualizeze soldul și istoricul complet al tranzacțiilor pentru un cont de copil, inclusiv sumele, datele și entitățile sau persoanele implicate în tranzacții. Dacă sunt disponibile, ar putea fi vizibile și detalii suplimentare despre tranzacții, precum descrierile furnizate în câmpul informativ al unei tranzacții din Mesaje. Pentru a vizualiza istoricul tranzacțiilor din contul de copil, apăsați pe cardul Apple Cash din Portofel, selectați Configurări Partajare familială > Partajare familială > Apple Cash > [numele copilului] > Tranzacții.

Copiii cu vârsta minimă de 13 ani pot încărca fonduri în contul lor Apple Cash. Orice încărcare de fonduri va fi vizibilă pentru proprietarul contului.

Când un copil împlinește 18 ani, poate solicita să preia în posesie contul său asociat și să îl promoveze într‑un cont Apple Cash autonom. După promovare, organizatorii familiei și părinții sau tutorii legali nu vor mai putea să acceseze informațiile contului copilului sau informații despre tranzacțiile Apple Cash trecute sau viitoare ale copilului. Contul promovat va continua să vadă informații despre tranzacțiile care au survenit înainte de absolvire.

În cazul în care copilul părăsește Familia, contul de copil asociat va fi închis, iar informațiile despre cont vor fi gestionate în conformitate cu cele de mai sus, în secțiunea „Închiderea contului dvs. Apple Cash”.

Pentru informații despre modul în care Apple gestionează datele personale ale copiilor, consultați pagina „Declarație privind confidențialitatea informațiilor despre familie și copii” de la www.apple.com/legal/privacy/ro/parent-disclosure.

Altele

Funcționalitățile pentru plățile directe sau sumele primite sunt furnizate de Apple Payments Inc., care este responsabilă pentru procesarea datelor personale asociate. Alte servicii tehnologice Apple Cash sunt furnizate de Apple Payments Services LLC, o filială deținută integral de Apple.

Dacă inițiați la instituția dvs. financiară o plângere despre o tranzacție Apple Cash frauduloasă, Green Dot Bank poate solicita ca Apple să partajeze cu Green Dot Bank anumite informații legate de tranzacția contestată pentru a facilita oferirea unui răspuns la cererea dvs., cum ar fi adresa IP, contul Apple, numărul de telefon și un identificator de dispozitiv. Green Dot Bank poate partaja aceste informații legate de tranzacție cu instituția dvs. financiară și cu rețeaua de plată (de exemplu, Visa sau American Express) pentru prevenirea fraudelor. Puteți afla mai multe despre modul în care Green Dot Bank protejează și partajează datele dvs. personale consultând politica de confidențialitate la adresa https://applecash.greendot.com/privacy.

Pentru a contribui la îmbunătățirea Apple Cash, Apple colectează informații despre modul în care utilizați Apple Cash și stochează informațiile respective într‑un mod care nu vă identifică personal. De asemenea, Apple poate utiliza aceste informații pentru a îmbunătăți alte produse și servicii Apple, în scopuri de marketing, de prevenire a fraudelor și de securitate. De asemenea, Apple poate accesa anumite informații anonimizate despre Apple Cash de la Green Dot Bank și poate utiliza acele informații pentru analiza comercială și îmbunătățirea Apple Cash și a serviciilor asociate.

Apple păstrează datele personale doar atât timp cât este necesar pentru a îndeplini scopul pentru care au fost colectate, inclusiv scopurile descrise în această înștiințare și în conformitate cu Politica de confidențialitate Apple, sau conform obligațiilor legale. Când evaluăm perioadele de retenție, mai întâi examinăm cu atenție dacă este necesar să păstrăm datele personale colectate și, dacă retenția este necesară, ne străduim să păstrăm datele personale pentru cea mai scurtă perioadă permisă de lege.

Informațiile colectate de Apple vor fi în permanență tratate în conformitate cu politica de confidențialitate Apple, care se află la www.apple.com/ro/privacy.

Apple Cash allows you to send and receive money from other people and to receive disbursements from and make direct payments to eligible businesses.

Making Person to Person Payments and Using Apple Cash (United States Only)

Apple Cash allows you to send and receive money from other people in Messages, Wallet, and using Siri. When you receive money, it’s added to your Apple Cash card that can be used to make purchases using Apple Pay in stores, in apps, and on the web. Person to person payments and the Apple Cash account are services provided by Apple’s partner bank, Green Dot Bank.

Setting Up Apple Cash

When you set up Apple Cash, your identifying information and contact information, as well as the same information as when you add a credit or debit card may be shared with Green Dot Bank and with Apple Payments Inc.

Apple created Apple Payments Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary and licensed money transmitter, to protect your privacy. Your Apple Cash account registration information (name, address), balance, transaction amount, and to which individuals you send money are stored separately by Apple Payments Inc. Your personal data stored with Apple Payments Inc. is used only to provide you services that you request, for troubleshooting, regulatory purposes, and to prevent fraud.

In addition, Apple Inc. will know if you have enabled Apple Cash, or used Apple Cash services, such as whether you have enabled Apple Cash Family. This information will be used only to help you discover and use Apple Cash and Apple Pay features.

Verifying Your Identity

You may be asked to provide information, including your name, address, and Social Security number, to the bank and their identity verification service provider to verify your identity and to comply with banking regulations. Information you provide to verify your identity will be used only for fraud prevention and to comply with United States financial regulations. Your name and address are securely stored by the partner bank and Apple Payments Inc. If needed to verify your identity, you may be asked to provide additional information, such as date of birth, answers to questions (for example, confirming a street name you have previously lived on), or a copy of your government ID. This additional information cannot be read by Apple Inc.

To help prevent fraud while protecting your privacy, your device may evaluate information about specific device and account use patterns, such as events indicative of scams or familiarity with a sender or recipient, and generate risk assessments designed to help prevent fraud. These risk assessments — but not the underlying information — are shared identifiably with Apple Payments Inc. and in a way that cannot be linked to you with Apple, are stored for a limited time, and are used in fraud decisions to safeguard your money when using Apple Cash (for example, preventing scams), prevent unauthorized use, and help ensure the overall safety of the Apple Cash platform. For example, when you provision Apple Cash, just as when you add a card to Apple Pay, your device may evaluate device use patterns (for example, percent of time device is in motion, approximate number of calls per week). No content of your communication is collected. Transactions requiring further analysis due to suspicious activity may be retained and linked to you. You can view which transactions required further analysis due to suspicious activity by going to your Apple Cash card transaction history.

Information Shared When You Use Apple Cash

When you use Apple Cash, including when you add money or transfer money to a bank account, our partner bank, Apple, and Apple Payments Inc. may use and store information about you, your device, and your bank account in order to process the transaction, prevent fraud, and comply with financial regulations. This information is similar to that processed when you add a credit or debit card, but does not include the location of your device. If you have enabled Location Services for Wallet, your device will also evaluate information about your device’s location to develop on-device fraud prevention assessments. The output of the assessments, but not the underlying data, will be sent to Apple. We may also share information with our partner bank or Apple for fraud prevention and to help provide you with support. Apple Payments Inc. will store and use your transaction data for troubleshooting, to prevent fraud, and to comply with financial regulations. To help protect you against scams, when you attempt a transaction that appears fraudulent, Apple Payments Inc. may request information from our partner bank about Apple Cash account-related events, such as when you last successfully verified your identity. Apple Payments Inc. will store and use this data to prevent fraud.

When you send or request money in Messages or Wallet, your email address or phone number will be shown to the people you transact with. To select or change the contact information shown when sending or requesting from Messages or Wallet, go to Settings > Apps > Messages > Send & Receive. When you transfer money to a bank account, your bank information, including account number and routing number, will be stored within iCloud Keychain to simplify future transfers. This information is encrypted and cannot be read by Apple or Apple Payments Inc.

To initiate a Tap to Cash transaction, you may configure a display name and photo and transaction amount on your device, authorize the amount, and then hold your device in close proximity to the recipient device to establish a device-to-device connection. Once the connection is established, your device will share the display name and photo you have configured and the transaction amount directly with the recipient device. The recipient then has the opportunity to review and accept the payment. If accepted, the recipient’s acceptance and their configured display name and photo are encrypted and shared back with your device. Details on the fully authorized transaction are then passed by your device to Apple Pay servers for processing.

Direct Payments and Disbursements

Apple Cash uses Apple Payments Inc. to allow participating businesses that you authorize to disburse funds directly to your Apple Cash account. Apple Payments Inc. also provides the Direct Payments Service, which allows you to use funds in your Apple Cash account to make payments to certain businesses that you authorize.

Information about disbursements you receive or direct payments that you make is used by Green Dot Bank and Apple Payments Inc. only to provide the service you have requested, to troubleshoot, to comply with applicable laws, and to prevent fraud for these transactions. Apple Payments Inc. retains transaction records, including transactions flagged as suspicious, as required by federal and state law for a period of up to five years.

To help ensure that any recurring or other merchant-initiated charges like subscriptions are authorized by you, when you choose to use Apple Cash as a payment method with participating merchants for recurring or merchant-initiated charges, Green Dot Bank and Visa will approve and generate a merchant-specific account number using Apple Pay’s merchant token feature to be used for such charges. Only that merchant-specific account number can be used by the specific participating merchant to authorize transactions without requiring you taking a specific action. Apple will know which merchants are associated with your merchant-specific account numbers, but not what you purchased or how much you paid for it. You can manage your Apple Cash merchant-specific account numbers in Wallet by tapping your Apple Cash card and tapping the More button to view card details.

When you use Apple Cash for a recurring payment to a friend or to automatically reload your Apple Cash balance, Apple Cash requests and stores a merchant token associated with your Apple Pay debit card(s) to securely authorize recurring transactions. Merchant token generation relies on Apple infrastructure, so Apple will know that you have set up either a recurring payment or auto reload, and the amount — but doesn’t know with whom you’re transacting or the memo you associated with the payment.

Closing Your Apple Cash Account

If you close your Apple Cash account, information about the account, including transaction history, will be retained as required by law and for fraud prevention.

Apple Cash Family

When Family Sharing is enabled, a Family Organizer may allow family members under the age of 18, including those under the age of 13, to use Apple Cash. Apple will use information provided in the Apple Cash Family onboarding flow and share such information with Green Dot Bank to set up the child account. Information about the Apple Cash account will also be shared with Green Dot Bank to provide the account, prevent fraud, and comply with law.

Family Organizers may limit to whom a child may send money using Messages; anyone can send money to the child’s account. Apple will store the restriction to enforce the Family Organizer’s choices. The Family Organizer may view and change the Apple Cash child account settings at any time by tapping their Apple Cash card in Wallet, selecting Family Sharing Settings > Family Sharing > Apple Cash and tapping the child’s name.

Family Organizers, and parents and legal guardians will also be able to view the balance and full transaction history for a child account, including amounts, dates, and entities or persons transacted with. Additional transaction details may also be shown if available, such as descriptions provided in the memo field of a transaction in Messages. To view the child account transaction history, tap the Apple Cash card in Wallet, select Family Sharing Settings > Family Sharing > Apple Cash > [child’s name] > Transactions.

Children aged 13 and over may load funds onto their Apple Cash account. Any loading of funds will be visible to the account owner.

When a child turns 18, they can request to take ownership of their linked account and graduate it to a standalone Apple Cash account. Upon graduation, Family Organizers and parents or legal guardians will no longer be able to access the child’s account information or information about the child’s past or future Apple Cash transactions. The graduated account will continue to see information about transactions that occurred prior to graduation.

If the child leaves the Family, the linked child account will be closed, and information about the account will be handled as described above in Closing Your Apple Cash Account.

For information on Apple’s handling of children’s personal data, see the Family Privacy Disclosure for Children at www.apple.com/legal/privacy/parent-disclosure.

Other

The direct payments or disbursements features described above are provided by Apple Payments Inc., which is responsible for the related personal data processing. Other Apple Cash technology services are provided by Apple Payments Services LLC, an Apple wholly owned subsidiary.

If you initiate a complaint with your financial institution about a fraudulent Apple Cash transaction, Green Dot Bank may request that Apple share with Green Dot Bank certain information relating to the disputed transaction to help respond to your inquiry, such as the IP address, Apple Account, telephone number, and a device identifier. Green Dot Bank may share this transaction-related information with your financial institution and the payment network (for example, Visa or American Express) for fraud prevention. You can learn more about how Green Dot Bank protects and shares your personal data by reviewing their privacy policy at https://applecash.greendot.com/privacy.

To help improve Apple Cash, Apple collects information about your use of Apple Cash and stores that information in a way that does not identify you personally. Apple may also use this information to improve other Apple products and services, for marketing, and for fraud and security purposes. Apple may also access certain deidentified Apple Cash information from Green Dot Bank and use that information for business analytics and to improve Apple Cash and related services.

Apple retains personal data only for so long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including as described in this notice and in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, or as required by law. When assessing retention periods, we first carefully examine whether it is necessary to retain the personal data collected and, if retention is required, work to retain the personal data for the shortest period permissible under law.

At all times, information collected by Apple will be treated in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, which can be found at www.apple.com/privacy.

ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਦੁਆਰਾ Apple Cash ਸੈੱਟ ਅੱਪ ਕਰਨ ’ਤੇ, ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਪਰਕ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ-ਨਾਲ ਉਹ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਜਿਸਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਜਾਂ ਡੈਬਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਜੋੜਨ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ Green Dot Bank ਅਤੇ Apple Payments Inc. ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ।

ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਪਰਦੇਦਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ Apple ਨੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਾਲਕੀ ਵਾਲੀ ਸਹਾਇਕ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਅਤੇ ਪੈਸੇ ਟ੍ਰਾਂਸਮਿਟ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਲਾਇਸੰਸਸ਼ੁਦਾ ਕੰਪਨੀ Apple Payments Inc. ਦੀ ਸਥਾਪਨਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ। ਤੁਹਾਡੇ Apple Cash ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ (ਨਾਮ, ਪਤਾ), ਬਕਾਇਆ, ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਰਕਮ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੈਸੇ ਭੇਜਦੇ ਹੋ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ Apple Payments Inc. ਵੱਲੋਂ ਵੱਖੋ-ਵੱਖਰੇ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ ਸਟੋਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। Apple Payments Inc. ਵਿੱਚ ਸਟੋਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਨ, ਸਮੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਹੱਲ ਕਰਨ, ਰੈਗੂਲੇਟਰੀ ਉਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਨੂੰ ਰੋਕਣ ਲਈ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।

ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ Apple Cash ਨੂੰ ਸਮਰੱਥ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ ਜਾਂ Apple Cash ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ Apple Inc. ਨੂੰ ਇਸਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਕੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ Apple Cash Family ਨੂੰ ਸਮਰੱਥ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ। ਇਸ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ Apple Cash ਅਤੇ Apple Pay ਫ਼ੀਚਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਪੜਚੋਲ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ।

ਜਦੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ ਜਾਂ ਰਕਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ Green Dot Bank ਅਤੇ Apple Payments Inc. ਰਾਹੀਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਨ, ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਦਾ ਹੱਲ ਕਰਨ, ਲਾਗੂ ਕਾਨੂੰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਨੂੰ ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। Apple Payments Inc. ਸ਼ੱਕੀ ਵਜੋਂ ਫ਼ਲੈਗ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਸਮੇਤ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਪੰਜ ਸਾਲਾਂ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਦ ਤੱਕ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਕਿ ਸੰਘੀ ਅਤੇ ਰਾਜਾਂ ਦੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਤਹਿਤ ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਇਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਕਿ ਕੋਈ ਵੀ ਵਾਰ-ਵਾਰ ਜਾਂ ਵਪਾਰੀ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਲਗਾਏ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੋਰ ਖ਼ਰਚੇ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਜੋ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ, ਜਦੋਂ ਵੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਭਾਗੀਦਾਰੀ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਵਾਰ-ਵਾਰ ਜਾਂ ਵਪਾਰੀ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਲਗਾਏ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੋਰ ਖ਼ਰਚਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਵਜੋਂ Apple Cash ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਉਦੋਂ Green Dot Bank ਅਤੇ Visa ਵੱਲੋਂ ਅਜਿਹੇ ਖ਼ਰਚਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ Apple Pay ਦੇ ਵਪਾਰੀ ਟੋਕਨ ਫ਼ੀਚਰ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਵਪਾਰੀ-ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ ਖਾਤਾ ਨੰਬਰ ਜਨਰੇਟ ਕਰਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਨਗੀ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ। ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਿਸੇ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਕਾਰਵਾਈ ਤੋਂ ਬਗ਼ੈਰ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਨੂੰ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਸਹਿਯੋਗੀ ਵਪਾਰੀ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਸੇ ਵਪਾਰੀ-ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ ਖਾਤਾ ਨੰਬਰ ਦੀ ਹੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। Apple ਨੂੰ ਪਤਾ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ ਕਿ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਵਪਾਰੀ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਪਾਰੀ-ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ ਖਾਤਾ ਨੰਬਰ ਨਾਲ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਇਹ ਪਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕੀ ਖ਼ਰੀਦਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਲਈ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਕੀਤਾ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦੇਖਣ ਲਈ Apple Cash ਕਾਰਡ ’ਤੇ ਟੈਪ ਕਰ ਕੇ “ਹੋਰ” ਬਟਨ ’ਤੇ ਟੈਪ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਵੌਲਿਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੇ Apple Cash ਵਪਾਰੀ-ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ ਖਾਤਾ ਨੰਬਰ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ।

ਜਦੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ Apple Cash ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੋਸਤ ਨੂੰ ਵਾਰ-ਵਾਰ ਦੁਹਰਾਇਆ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਜਾਂ ਆਪਣਾ Apple Cash ਬਕਾਇਆ ਆਟੋਮੈਟਿਕਲੀ ਰੀਲੋਡ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ Apple Cash ਵਾਰ-ਵਾਰ ਦੁਹਰਾਇਆ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਭੁਗਤਾਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ Apple Pay ਡੈਬਿਟ ਕਾਰਡਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਵਪਾਰੀ ਟੋਕਨ ਲਈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਸਟੋਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਮਰਚੈਂਟ ਟੋਕਨ ਜਨਰੇਟ ਕਰਨਾ Apple ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਢਾਂਚੇ ’ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ Apple ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਪਤਾ ਲੱਗੇਗਾ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਵਰਤੀ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਜਾਂ ਆਟੋ ਰੀਲੋਡ ਅਤੇ ਰਕਮ ਨੂੰ ਸੈੱਟ ਅੱਪ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ - ਪਰ ਇਹ ਪਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਗੇਗਾ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਹੋ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਨਾਲ ਕੀ ਮੈਮੋ ਜੋੜਿਆ ਹੈ।

ਆਪਣਾ Apple Cash ਖਾਤਾ ਬੰਦ ਕਰਨਾ

ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣਾ Apple Cash ਖਾਤਾ ਬੰਦ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਸਮੇਤ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਲੋੜਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਰੋਕਣ ਲਈ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ।

Apple Cash ਪਰਿਵਾਰ

ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਸਾਂਝਾਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਚਾਲੂ ਹੋਣ ’ਤੇ, ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਆਯੋਜਕ ਵੱਲੋਂ ^[13](formatNumber: true) ਸਾਲ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਉਮਰ ਦੇ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਸਮੇਤ, ^[18](formatNumber: true) ਸਾਲ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਉਮਰ ਦੇ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ Apple Cash ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਇਜਾਜ਼ਤ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ Apple Cash ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਔਨਬੋਰਡਿੰਗ ਫ਼ਲੋ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਗਈ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਬੱਚੇ ਦਾ ਖਾਤਾ ਸੈੱਟ ਅੱਪ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ Green Dot Bank ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। Apple Cash ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ Green Dot Bank ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ ਤਾਂ ਕਿ ਖਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ, ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਨੂੰ ਰੋਕਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ।

ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਕ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਸੀਮਤ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਸੁਨੇਹੇ ਐਪ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਬੱਚਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੈਸੇ ਭੇਜ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ; ਬੱਚੇ ਦੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰ ਕੋਈ ਪੈਸੇ ਭੇਜ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਕ ਦੀਆਂ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲਾਗੂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਪਾਬੰਦੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਟੋਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ। ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਕ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਬੱਚੇ ਦੇ Apple Cash ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀਆਂ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਵੌਲਿਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸ ਦੇ Apple Cash ਕਾਰਡ ’ਤੇ ਟੈਪ ਕਰਕੇ, ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਸਾਂਝਾਕਰਨ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ > ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਸਾਂਝਾਕਰਨ > Apple Cash ਨੂੰ ਚੁਣ ਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ’ਤੇ ਟੈਪ ਕਰਕੇ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਬਦਲਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਕ, ਮਾਪੇ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਸਰਪ੍ਰਸਤਾਂ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਮਿਤੀਆਂ, ਐਂਟਿਟੀਆਂ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਕੀਤੇ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਸਮੇਤ ਬੱਚੇ ਦੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਦਾ ਬਕਾਇਆ ਅਤੇ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਉਪਲਬਧ ਹੋਣ ’ਤੇ ਸੁਨੇਹਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦੇ ਮੈਮੋ ਫ਼ੀਲਡ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਗਏ ਵੇਰਵਿਆਂ ਵਰਗੇ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦੇ ਵਾਧੂ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਵੀ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ। ਬੱਚੇ ਦੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਹਿਸਟਰੀ ਦੇਖਣ ਲਈ ਵੌਲਿਟ ਵਿੱਚ Apple Cash ਕਾਰਡ ’ਤੇ ਟੈਪ ਕਰੋ, ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਸਾਂਝਾਕਰਨ ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ > ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਸਾਂਝਾਕਰਨ > Apple Cash > [ਬੱਚੇ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ] > ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਕਰੋ।

^[13](formatNumber: true) ਸਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਉਮਰ ਦੇ ਬੱਚੇ ਆਪਣੇ Apple Cash ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਫ਼ੰਡ ਲੋਡ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ। ਕੋਈ ਲੋਡ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਫ਼ੰਡ ਖਾਤੇ ਦੇ ਮਾਲਕ ਨੂੰ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੇਵੇਗਾ।

ਜਦੋਂ ਬੱਚੇ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ ^[18](formatNumber: true) ਸਾਲ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਉਹ ਆਪਣੇ ਲਿੰਕ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਮਾਲਕੀ ਲੈਣ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ Apple Cash ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਅੱਪਗ੍ਰੇਡ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਅੱਪਗ੍ਰੇਡ ਹੋਣ ’ਤੇ, ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਕ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਪੇ ਜਾਂ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਸਰਪ੍ਰਸਤ ਬੱਚੇ ਦੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਬੱਚੇ ਦੇ ਅਤੀਤ ਜਾਂ ਭਵਿੱਖ ਦੇ Apple Cash ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਐਕਸੈੱਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰ ਸਕਣਗੇ। ਅੱਪਗ੍ਰੇਡ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਜਾ ਸਕੇਗੀ।

ਜੇਕਰ ਬੱਚਾ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਬੱਚੇ ਦਾ ਲਿੰਕ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਖਾਤਾ ਬੰਦ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ ਅਤੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਉੱਪਰ “Apple Cash ਖਾਤਾ ਬੰਦ ਕਰਨਾ” ਵਿੱਚ ਦੱਸੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਵਿਹਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਆਂਦਾ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ।

Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਬੱਚੇ ਦਾ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖਣ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਵਧੇਰੇ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਲਈ www.apple.com/in/legal/privacy/en-ww/parent-disclosure ’ਤੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਪਰਦੇਦਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਾ ਦੇਖੋ।

ਹੋਰ

ਉੱਪਰ ਦੱਸੇ ਗਏ ਸਿੱਧੇ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਜਾਂ ਅਦਾਇਗੀਆਂ ਫ਼ੀਚਰ Apple Payments Inc. ਵੱਲੋਂ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਜੋ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਲਈ ਜ਼ਿੰਮੇਵਾਰ ਹਨ। ਹੋਰ Apple Cash ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ Apple Payments Services LLC, Apple ਦੀ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਮਾਲਕੀ ਵਾਲੀ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।

ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ Apple Cash ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਿੱਤੀ ਸੰਸਥਾ ਨੂੰ ਸ਼ਿਕਾਇਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ Green Dot Bank ਵੱਲੋਂ Apple ਨੂੰ ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਵਾਲੇ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਪੁੱਛਗਿੱਛ ਦਾ ਜਵਾਬ ਦੇਣ ਲਈ IP ਪਤਾ, Apple ਖਾਤਾ, ਟੈਲੀਫ਼ੋਨ ਨੰਬਰ ਅਤੇ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਪਛਾਣਕਰਤਾ ਵਰਗੀ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ Green Dot Bank ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। Green Dot Bank ਵੱਲੋਂ ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਰੋਕਣ ਲਈ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਵਿੱਤੀ ਸੰਸਥਾ ਅਤੇ (Visa ਜਾਂ American Express ਵਰਗੇ) ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਨੈੱਟਵਰਕ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। Green Dot Bank ਵੱਲੋਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਦੀ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ ਵਧੇਰੇ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਲਈ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਰਦੇਦਾਰੀ ਨੀਤੀ ਦੀ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ ਜੋ https://applecash.greendot.com/privacy ’ਤੇ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਹੈ।

Apple Cash ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ, Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ Apple Cash ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਇਕੱਠੀ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਟੋਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਪਛਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ। Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਇਸ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ Apple ਦੇ ਹੋਰ ਉਤਪਾਦਾਂ ਤੇ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਧਾਰਨ, ਮਾਰਕਿਟਿੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਧੋਖਾਧੜੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਉਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਲਈ ਵੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ Green Dot Bank ਦੀ ਕੁਝ ਗੈਰ-ਪਛਾਣਯੋਗ Apple Cash ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਵੀ ਐਕਸੈੱਸ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰੀ ਵਿਸ਼ਲੇਸ਼ਕੀ, Apple Cash ਅਤੇ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ।

Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਦੋਂ ਤੱਕ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਦੋਂ ਤੱਕ ਇਹ ਇਸ ਨੋਟਸ ਅਤੇ Apple ਦੀ ਪਰਦੇਦਾਰੀ ਨੀਤੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੱਸੇ ਗਏ ਸਮੇਤ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਇਕੱਠਾ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਉਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਜਾਂ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖਣ ਦੇ ਅਰਸੇ ਦਾ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਅਸੀਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਇਸਦੀ ਪੜਚੋਲ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਕੀ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡੇਟਾ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਂਭਣਾ ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜੇ ਹਾਂ, ਤਾਂ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ ਮਾਨਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਘੱਟ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਸਮੇਂ ਲਈ ਸਾਂਭਣ ਦਾ ਕੰਮ ਕਰੋ।

Apple ਵੱਲੋਂ ਇਕੱਤਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾਂ Apple ਦੀ ਪਰਦੇਦਾਰੀ ਨੀਤੀ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ। ਇਸ ਨੂੰ www.apple.com/in/privacy ’ਤੇ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।
